scope: Publication consistency and exact English translations of existing policy version 1 fee/time rules only.
sourceLanguageCaveat: Arabic and English cards differ in eligibility wording; those conditions are explicitly outside this change.

facts.fees: رسم تصريح الإقامة: 200 درهم، و10 دراهم درهم معرفة، و10 دراهم درهم ابتكار، و500 درهم رسم داخل الدولة عند انطباقه، و20 درهم توصيل. تزيد رسوم الإصدار 100 درهم سنويًا عندما تتجاوز الإقامة سنتين.
facts.duration: مدة الإنجاز المتوقعة المنشورة رسميًا: 48 ساعة.
facts.feesEn: Residence permit fee: AED 200; AED 10 knowledge fee, AED 10 innovation fee, AED 500 in-country fee where applicable, and AED 20 delivery. The issuance fee increases by AED 100 annually when the residence exceeds two years.
facts.durationEn: Officially published expected completion time: 48 hours.
